messages:
Nora PM: quick sync — three enterprise pilots are asking for an "'accelerated GA'" path to a 99.99% Dedicated SLA but want a clear activation checklist. Can we define a safe GA rubric this week?
Eli Eng: high level: we can offer staged activation. mechanics: feature toggle per-customer, per-route burst reservation, and deterministic KV-warm paths. estimate 2-4 sprints depending on guarantees.
Sana SRE: ops gate list I'd require: capacity soak 72h, no Sev1 for 14d post-soak, golden metrics in Console, and automated rollback via toggle. also need audit log delivery verified.
Carla Sales: pilots want credits if we miss SLA, but with a cap. they'd accept a phased calendar: Pilot->Ramp->Full with credit unlocking only at Full.
Hiro Legal: we'll need precise measurement windows + formula for credits and maintenance carve-outs. also define who authorizes stage flips (product + infra lead).
Maya Docs: doc gaps: missing customer-facing "Tiered SLA" explainer and internal activation checklist. I can draft both once we have gates and credit formula. ETA 3 business days.
Nora PM: proposed GA rule: do not promise full 99.99% at GA unless at least one pilot completed Full stage and we automate soak + alerts. For GA we can offer up to 99.95 with a clear upgrade path.
Eli Eng: implementation snippet for per-customer config:
```
customer_sla:
  tiered: true
  stage: ramp
  burst_reservation: 20
  credit_cap_months: 3
  measurement_window: rolling_30d
```
Eli Eng: toggle + tagging + basic UI flag ~ 2 sprints; deterministic reservation & KV warm ~ another 2 sprints.
Sana SRE: monitoring: tag metrics by customer_id, add panels for latency_p50/p95/p99, qps, slot_util, audit_lag. alert if p99 > 250ms for 5m or error_rate > 0.5% for 10m.
Carla Sales: I'll propose credit cap language (max 3 months invoice) and pilot holdback: credits withheld until Full stage passes. Customers prefer it if we give partial credits during Ramp but understand holdback.
Hiro Legal: carve-outs we need: scheduled_maintenance, customer misconfiguration, force majeure, third-party provider outages. I'll draft SLA appendix.
Maya Docs: once legal text is in, I'll make an activation checklist with owners: Eng, SRE, Legal, Sales, Docs.
ops-bot: Created PROD-15099 "Tiered Dedicated SLA: activation checklist, toggle, metrics tagging"  assignees: @Eli Eng, @Sana SRE.
Nora PM: decision items for GA acceptance of any customer's 99.99 ask:
- At least one pilot reached Full stage (post-30d stability)
- Automation for soak + alerts in Console
- Runbook + oncall checklist published
- Credit formula + legal signoff + credit caps set
- Toggle + deterministic fallback implemented
If any missing -> offer 99.95 + staged upgrade path.
Eli Eng: I'll start the tagging PR today and sketch the toggle API.
Sana SRE: will schedule the first soak run for next Wed and attach logs to the ticket.
Carla Sales: I'll align pilot proposals to the staged approach and share with customers.
Hiro Legal: sharing SLA appendix draft in 48h.
Maya Docs: will post draft explainer + internal checklist PR after legal lands.
Nora PM: thanks team. check-in Friday EOD. call me out if blockers. :thumbsup:
